Artist biography

HAWTDVWGE (pronounced ‘hot dog’) is a faceless bass music project from San Diego, California. Before the mask, there was a musician: guitar, alto and baritone saxophone, music theory, and years writing and performing in metal bands. Electronic production became another way to explore the same creative impulse.

Since 2011, that exploration has moved through electro house, dubstep, psy-trance, hardstyle, future bass and hybrid trap under several aliases. Today, HAWTDVWGE brings those worlds together, usually somewhere between 90 and 175 BPM. Everything runs on contrast — minimal to maximal, silence to impact, melodic to chaotic.

Music is a home away from the noise of everyday life. The goal is to open that home to everyone, regardless of background: a safe place to feel something, even if only for a moment.
